name: jadwal-adb
description: Bel Sekolah ADB - SMK Negeri 1 Adiwerna (Server, Web Admin, Windows Desktop Player)

scripts.build:win: npm run build:shared && npm run build:win --workspace=@jadwal-adb/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@jadwal-adb/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@jadwal-adb/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@jadwal-adb/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@jadwal-adb/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@jadwal-adb/shared && npm run test --workspace=@jadwal-adb/server
